title: Feature Selection
subtitle: Removing irrelevant features to improve models

content.text: Fewer features reduce overfitting, speed up training, and make models more interpretable. Remove features that add noise.

content.code:
from sklearn.feature_selection import SelectKBest, f_classif, RFE
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier

# Select top 10 features by ANOVA F-statistic
selector = SelectKBest(score_func=f_classif, k=10)
X_new = selector.fit_transform(X_train, y_train)

# Recursive Feature Elimination
rf = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100)
rfe = RFE(estimator=rf, n_features_to_select=10)
rfe.fit(X_train, y_train)
print("Selected features:", [features[i] for i in range(len(features)) if rfe.support_[i]])

questions.question: What is the purpose of RFE?
options: To recursively remove the least important features
questions.explanation: RFE (Recursive Feature Elimination) iteratively trains the model and removes the least important feature until the desired number remains.

faq.q: Can feature importance from Random Forest be misleading?
faq.a: Yes. RF feature importance can favour high-cardinality features. Use permutation importance for a more reliable estimate.
